cases.name: oracle slash alone ends a statement, mid-line it divides
oracle WITH FUNCTION runs until the slash
oracle EXEC ends at the line end and continues with a hyphen
oracle SQL*Plus commands end at the line, SET TRANSACTION stays SQL
cases.sql:
SET DEFINE OFF
PROMPT loading; it's fine
REM a;b
SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
UPDATE t
SET x = 1;
SPOOL out.log
WHENEVER SQLERROR EXIT ROLLBACK
EXIT
